claims: The Toyota bZ7 electric sedan achieved over 3,100 orders within the first hour of its launch in China.
The Toyota bZ7 launched in late March 2026.
The Toyota bZ7 starts at approximately 147,800 yuan (~$21,500).
The Toyota bZ7 features partnerships with Huawei, Xiaomi, and Momenta.
Over 3,100 units of the Toyota bZ7 were ordered within 60 minutes of the launch event.
The Toyota bZ7 starts around 147,800 Chinese yuan ($21,500).
The Toyota bZ7 is priced up to 199,800 yuan ($29,000).
The Toyota bZ7 is developed in collaboration with Chinese technology firms.
The Toyota bZ7 offers LiDAR-based driver-assistance systems (ADAS).
The Toyota bZ7 offers a choice of 71-kWh or 88-kWh batteries.
The Toyota bZ7 batteries provide up to 710 km (441 miles) of range.
According to Electrive, the Toyota bZ7 is now available in Chinese dealerships.
According to Electrive, deliveries of the Toyota bZ7 are already beginning.
